# GitHub Repository Setup Checklist

Some GitHub presence improvements cannot be fully applied from the repository files alone. Use this checklist in the GitHub repository settings.

## Repository Description

Suggested description:

```text
Interactive real-time finite element analysis for structural mechanics education
```

## Website

```text
https://jonaslindemann.github.io/objectiveframe/
```

## Topics

Suggested topics:

```text
finite-element-analysis
fea
structural-analysis
structural-mechanics
beam-analysis
educational-fem
open-source-fea
civil-engineering
engineering-education
opengl
cpp
calfem
eigen
```

## Discussions

Enable GitHub Discussions and add categories such as:

- Questions
- Ideas
- Teaching
- Examples
- Show and tell

Discussion templates have been added under `.github/DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE`.

## Labels

Create or keep these labels so issue and discussion forms can classify new entries cleanly:

- `bug`
- `enhancement`
- `question`
- `idea`
- `documentation`
- `examples`
- `teaching`

## Social Proof

- Pin one or two polished example discussions.
- Invite users to share classroom examples and screenshots.
- Link to short videos from the README and docs home page.
- Add release notes with screenshots for major releases.
- Encourage users to star the repository if ObjectiveFrame helps their teaching or research.
